name: アドレスとタブ操作をまとめたブラウザー下部ナビゲーション
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0111 アドレスとタブ操作をまとめたブラウザー下部ナビゲーション.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: normalized-original-source-component-crop-366x115. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Create one Japanese Lighthouse bottom browser navigation component at exactly 366x115, matching the normalized source crop. Image 1 is the full source screenshot for context; Image 2 is the exact 366x115 component crop and controls geometry, controls, icon anatomy and line weight; Image 3 is the Japanese preview and controls localized content and current visible state; Image 4 controls palette only. Reproduce the crop as a standalone component with no phone, status bar, page content or watermark. Preserve the crop outer bounds and compact-but-comfortable spacing. Use one white rounded address/search capsule with a fine neutral border and quiet shadow, the exact centered text 「検索ページ」, the preview's existing bidirectional-arrow control and a single small green circular marker at the right. Below it, align five evenly spaced touch controls in the exact order: back, share, new-tab plus, square tab-count with 「2」, and more menu. Keep glyphs slate #526173 and match the source optical size/stroke. Use pure white canvas and surfaces, no gray/mint wash. Apply the exact Lighthouse linear gradient 135deg #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100% only to the existing green current-state marker; do not add a CTA or recolor utility icons. Preserve exact Japanese text and typography, no new labels or icons, no excessive padding, no empty margins outside the recorded crop, no extra card wrapping the entire component.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Use the approved forest-green gradient only on the existing small active/current-page marker. Render every navigation/action icon in slate #526173. Address/search and canvas remain pure white; no broad tint or decorative category colors.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at normalized 366x115 against the original crop and Japanese preview; source-width address field, exact Japanese label and control order, slate utility icons, and one green state marker. Candidate image only; native editability and app behavior are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
